title: Redemption of the Firstborn
summary: The redemption of the firstborn remembered God’s deliverance in Egypt and taught that the firstborn belonged to the Lord.
background: After the exodus, Israel was commanded to consecrate the firstborn and redeem them according to the law. This kept deliverance memory alive in family worship.
teachingHelp: Connect the custom to redemption, remembrance, and belonging to the Lord rather than treating it as an isolated ritual.
